figures.name: Katherine Johnson
figures.details: Katherine Johnson was a mathematician whose calculations of orbital mechanics were crucial to NASA's missions.

figures.name: Mae Jemison
figures.details: Mae Jemison was the first African American woman to travel in space aboard the Space Shuttle Endeavour.

figures.name: Sally Ride
figures.details: Sally Ride was the first American woman in space, flying aboard the Space Shuttle Challenger.

figures.name: Neil Armstrong
figures.details: Neil Armstrong was the first person to walk on the Moon during the Apollo 11 mission in 1969.

figures.name: Yuri Gagarin
figures.details: Yuri Gagarin was the first human to journey into outer space and orbit the Earth aboard Vostok 1 in 1961.

figures.name: Buzz Aldrin
figures.details: Buzz Aldrin was the second person to walk on the Moon, following Neil Armstrong during the Apollo 11 mission.

figures.name: Valentina Tereshkova
figures.details: Valentina Tereshkova was the first woman to fly in space, orbiting the Earth aboard Vostok 6 in 1963.

figures.name: John Glenn
figures.details: John Glenn was the first American to orbit the Earth, and later became the oldest person to fly in space at the age of 77.

figures.name: Wernher von Braun
figures.details: Wernher von Braun was a German-American aerospace engineer who developed the rockets that sent humans to the Moon.

figures.name: Alan Shepard
figures.details: Alan Shepard was the first American in space and later walked on the Moon as part of Apollo 14.

figures.name: Christa McAuliffe
figures.details: Christa McAuliffe was a schoolteacher who was selected to be the first civilian astronaut aboard the Space Shuttle Challenger.

figures.name: Georgy Dobrovolski
figures.details: Georgy Dobrovolski was a Soviet cosmonaut and the commander of Soyuz 11, the spaceflight that ended tragically when the crew perished.
